title: Markooj community add-ins
description: The list of add-ins that Markooj shows in File > Add-ins > Browse. One entry per add-in; add yours with a pull request.

id.description: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, such as word-count. It must equal the id in the add-in's manifest.json.

name.description: The name shown on the add-in's card, on one line.

author.description: Your name or your team's name, on one line.

description.description: One sentence about what the add-in does, on one line, at most 250 characters.

repo.description: The GitHub repository as owner/name, such as datakeen/markooj-addin-template.

category.description: One of: writing, research, math, languages, export, productivity, developer, fun, other.

items.description: Lowercase words for search, such as citations or word-count.
